def myRev : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => myRev xs ++ [x]

-- Lemma: myRev distributes over ++ in reverse order
theorem myRev_append (xs ys : List α) : myRev (xs ++ ys) = myRev ys ++ myRev xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [myRev, List.append_nil]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp [myRev, List.cons_append]
      rw [List.append_assoc, ih, List.append_assoc]
      <;> simp [myRev]
      <;> rfl

-- Now the main theorem
theorem myRev_myRev (xs : List α) : myRev (myRev xs) = xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [myRev]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [myRev, List.concat_singleton_distrib, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc] at *
      <;> simp_all [myRev_append, ih]
      <;> rfl
EOF
